datasets.jocry: jocry/Pumpfun_Memecoin_Corpus (card: MIT in YAML, CC BY 4.0 in body). Trade tape usable Jun 5-24 2026 only; tape truncated at ~2h after launch (most days) and ~20 min after launch from Jun 25 -> 2h-horizon label.
datasets.loophole: loopholetape/pumpfun-launches (CC BY 4.0), Aug 31-Oct 4 2026, no trade tape; rugged/graduated labels.

label_main: dead_v2@2h: no trade in [launch+1h, launch+2h] OR price(launch+2h) <= 0.1 x price(launch+2min); graduated coins via post-graduation DEX snapshots
population: jocry coins with >=1 trade by first sight (launch+2min), launched Jun 5-24, non-suspect: 308,041 coins
protocol: walk-forward, 3 test blocks (Jun15-17, Jun19-21, Jun22-24), train = all coins launched before block start - 2h; early stopping + accuracy threshold on the last train day; no shuffling

true_6h_checks.verdict: REJECTED as label: 6h survivors are coins idle in hour 1-2 that trade again near 5.9h; hour-of-day is a top feature -> collector re-scan artifact. Base dead at 6h on curve coins = 99.4%.
